messages:
alisa: Heads-up  we go live with MarketEntry partner tile at 09:00 PT tomorrow. Need a compact partner-SEV path that covers marketplace UI, partner-auth, and SI integration points. Keep it scriptable.

marco: Agreed. Minimal flow: shared ops channel -> partner triage -> Redwood oncall -> partner eng. Add region fallback and a warm-watch roster for first 36h.

Priyanka: Can we standardize the shared channel pattern to support auto-discovery? propose: #me-launch-<partner>-<env> (e.g. #me-launch-marketentry-prod). Pin runbook + contacts.

evan: Also recommend tagging alerts with surface (ui|auth|si) and customer_impact boolean. Automations can route to correct PD policy. Example rule: if alert.surface=="auth" -> PD_AUTH policy, else PD_MARKET.

alisa: Nice. Ops checklist (short): incident_owner, surface, region, customers_impacted Y/N, mitigation, rollback_token, bridge_link. Pin it and auto-fill from first alert.

ops-bot: action: /scaffold-channel me-launch-marketentry-prod --pins runbook.md,checklist.md --invite @alisa,@marco,@Priyanka,@evan; /route-alerts alert.group=marketentry.launch -> #me-launch-marketentry-prod

marco: Escalation timeline suggestion: 0-10m partner/SI triage in channel -> 10-30m Redwood oncall engaged -> 30-60m partner eng deep-dive -> 60m+ open warroom + exec-notify if P1.

Priyanka: I'll draft a tiny pinned runbook including PD ids and the warm-watch schedule (1hr shifts for first 12h, then 3hr checks through 36h). Also adding a comms snippet for partner CSMs to reuse.

evan: Can we have a policy: if any combined-surface alert (two different surfaces) fires or severity==P1 -> auto-create bridge with template "marketentry-launch-warroom" and page both PD policies.

ops-bot: automation rule created: if alert.surfaces_count>=2 OR alert.severity=="P1" -> /bridge create marketentry-launch-warroom --ops @alisa,@marco,@Priyanka --duration 3h; page PD_MARKET,PD_AUTH

marco: Also add a postmortem ownership rule: any Sev2+ within 72h -> assign partner_eng_lead + release_manager as owners. Prevents detective work later.

alisa: Great. I'll add a one-line ops paragraph to the announcement draft linking to the channel and runbook. Priyanka, once your draft is in, can you run the dry-run alert so we validate webhooks and PD policies?

Priyanka: Yep will do a dry-run tonight and drop results. Also adding a short rollback guardrail for auth changes (toggle + safe-token id).

evan: LGTM. One more ask  auto-post status every 30m during an active incident with: owner, surface, status, next-step. Helps partner ops and CSMs.

ops-bot: noted: /auto-status #me-launch-marketentry-prod every 30m while incident.active -> fields [owner,surface,status,next_steps]

alisa: Thanks team. Clean, machine-friendly, and human-readable  exactly what we need. I'll publish the announcement with the ops link after the dry-run passes. :thumbsup:
